text.answer: Aurelion Sol is a mage whose damaging abilities collect permanent Stardust to improve his abilities. He channels a sustained magic-damage beam and can use it while flying over terrain. His damage scales with AP.
text.counterplay: Break contact with his beam, leave his black hole, and spread out around his star impacts.

text.answer: Astral Flight carries Aurelion Sol over terrain while allowing him to cast abilities. During flight, Breath of Light has no cooldown or channel-duration limit and deals increased flat damage, but channeling slows his flight. Immobilizing crowd control stops his flight, and a champion takedown shortly after he damages them greatly reduces its cooldown.
text.counterplay: Use immobilizing crowd control to interrupt his flight and respect renewed pursuit after a takedown.

text.answer: Singularity creates a black hole that continuously deals magic damage and drags enemies toward its center. The center executes enemies at low health, excluding epic monsters. It grants Stardust for time champions spend inside and for enemies killed within its area.
text.counterplay: Leave the black hole promptly and keep away from its center when low on health.
